title: Closure under universal polynomial witnesses
statement: Let $i$ be a nonzero natural number, and let $L,L'$ be languages of finite binary strings with $L'\in\Pi_i^P$. For any natural numbers $C,c$, if for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to membership of $\langle x,u\rangle$ in $L'$ for every binary string $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$, then $L\in\Pi_i^P$.
hypotheses_covered: $L,L'$ are languages of finite binary strings
For every $x$, $x\in L$ iff every $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$ has $\langle x,u\rangle\in L'$
